status: Proposed exact subset; separate root approval required for this supplemental manifest own path and hash. Primary publication must include this manifest.
scope: Original-path test inputs plus bounded immutable owner reports, negative evidence and reproduction sources. No owner evidence file or owner publication manifest was changed.
hardExclusions: No compiled binaries, rlibs/rmeta, WASM, fonts, databases, generated design samples or encoded payload dumps. Only three explicitly approved 480x280 CPU PNG files are included.
attribution: Original owner evidence remains tied to its recorded historical candidate. Canvas candidate timing is not corrected-Canvas timing; native historical benchmarks are not corrected-decoder measurements. Root coordinated results and independent corrected addenda are separate.
machineLocalPaths: Some immutable original owner logs/commands retain historical machine-local paths. They are attribution, not supported literal replay locations. Use portable independent source views in the final evidence directory or explicitly adapt historical commands in a fresh external copy; do not mutate retained owner evidence.
reproductionLimits: The three optional-startup before.tsx snapshots are needed at exactly these original paths by shipped source-contract tests.
agent-refinement.json is an actual shipped-test input; its observed PNG digest is checked separately against product-cpu-after.png.
Optional-startup reproduction needs existing installed client dependencies. Its comparison scripts write evidence outputs, so use an external copy for a rerun rather than overwrite retained history.

Native build-codec-fixture.sh sources a historical absolute rust-env.sh and expects prebuilt dependency rlibs. It is not a portable one-command bootstrap; rebuild the retained fixture source against the matching toolchain/target in an external copy.

Canvas benchmark-test.tsx and saved baseline/candidate source files expect frontend/design-client/src relative imports. They are snapshots to place in an isolated reproduction tree, not standalone runnable files in the evidence folder.

The two shipped font test files no longer read historical generated TTFs; the new source helper/generator uses the baseline bundled font and explicitly installed pinned fonttools. Root coordinated rerun remains a separate approval gate.
